title: without --harness, setup hook guards every harness whose program is on PATH
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. The default set is each of claude, codex, opencode and pi whose program is on PATH. Here the fake claude and a codex and a pi in the sandbox home are on PATH, opencode is not: the plan writes the Claude Code, Codex and Pi files and leaves OpenCode alone.
